sloka: अद्य उपादाय तम् मार्गम् अभिषिक्तः अनुपालय ।यथा स्म लालिताः पित्रा यथा पूर्वैः पितामहैः ॥२-१७-९॥
transliteration: adya upādāya tam mārgam abhiṣiktaḥ anupālaya ।yathā sma lālitāḥ pitrā yathā pūrvaiḥ pitāmahaiḥ ॥2-17-9॥

translations.english: Once Rama assumes kingship, we shall all live in happiness greater than when we were ruled by his father and grandfather.
